def load():

    return G

    cols={c for _,c,_ in centers}; rows={r for r,_,_ in centers}

H,W=len(I3),len(I3[0])
def comps(cands):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for p in cands:
        if p in seen: continue
        st=[p]; comp=[]
        while st:
            cur=st.pop()
            if cur in seen: continue
            seen.add(cur); comp.append(cur)
            r,c=cur
            for dr in (-1,0,1):
                for dc in (-1,0,1):
                    n=(r+dr,c+dc)
                    if n not in cands or n in seen: continue
                    st.append(n)
        out.append(comp)
    return out

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    ctrs=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c] not in (0,3)]
    def is_own_arm(r,c,cr,cc): return abs(r-cr)+abs(c-cc)==1
    claims={}  # cell -> list of (color, vert?) in reading order
    for cr,cc,cv in sorted(ctrs,key=lambda t:(t[0],t[1])):
        color=cv
        for dv,dc in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)):
            hvert = (dv==0)
            r,c=cr+dv,cc+dc
            while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W:
                v=I[r][c]
                if v==3:
                    if is_own_arm(r,c,cr,cc): r+=dv; c+=dc; continue
                    break
                claims.setdefault((r,c),[]).append((color,hvert))
                r+=dv; c+=dc
    for cell,_ in list(claims.items()):
        cl=claims[cell]
        wins=[x for x in cl if x[1]]; hrs=[x for x in cl if not x[1]]
        if wins: O[cell[0]][cell[1]]=wins[0][0]
        elif hrs: O[cell[0]][cell[1]]=hrs[-1][0]
    return O
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    ctrs=sorted((r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c] not in (0,3))
    # two-pass: first compute ownership by later-center rule via simulation, but simpler: assign each cell winner directly
    claims={}
    for cr,cc,cv in ctrs:
        for dv,dc in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)):
            r,c=cr+dv,cc+dc
            while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W:
                v=I[r][c]
                if v==3 and abs(r-cr)+abs(c-cc)==1:  # own arm -> continue
                    r+=dv; c+=dc; continue
                if v==3: break
                claims.setdefault((r,c),[]).append((color:=cv,dv==0))
                r+=dv; c+=dc
    for cell,cl in claims.items():
        wins=[x for x in cl if x[1]]
        hrs=[x for x in cl if not x[1]]
        if wins: O[cell[0]][cell[1]]=wins[-1][0]
        elif hrs: O[cell[0]][cell[1]]=hrs[-1][0]
    return O

    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    ctrs=sorted((r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c] not in (0,3))

        for dv,dc in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)):

                if v==3: break                                           # any foreign 3 blocks
                if painted[r][c]: break                                 # earlier painter won
                painted[r][c]=True; O[r][c]=cv
                r+=dv;c+=dc
    return O

def simple(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    ctrs=sorted((r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c] not in (0,3))
    painted=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for cr,cc,cv in ctrs:
        for dv,dc in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)):
            r,c=cr+dv,cc+dc
            while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W:
                v=I[r][c]
                if abs(r-cr)+abs(c-cc)==1: r+=dv;c+=dc;continue
                if v==3: break
                if painted[r][c]: break
                painted[r][c]=True; O[r][c]=cv
                r+=dv;c+=dc
    return O
